proof_0313.moves: Reduce the claim that the intersection of all Iic(q) over rationals is empty to the criterion 'the intersection of lower-sets over a family is empty iff that family's range is not bounded below', then supply the fact that the image of the rationals in the reals is unbounded below.

proof_0314.moves: Apply extensionality for pseudometric spaces: two structures agree once their distance functions agree, and here the replaced-topology copy has the same dist by construction, so the pointwise equality is refl.

proof_0315.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the bundled ring hom's underlying function is literally Matrix.diagonal, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0316.moves: Definitional: mapping g over a constant simple function is by construction the constant at g b, so rfl closes it. The content is entirely in how map and const are defined.

proof_0317.moves: Observe that aeval x is an algebra homomorphism and therefore sends 1 to 1; the proof is a single application of the generic map_one lemma.

proof_0318.moves: This is the mechanically reassociated form of functorMap_comp: take the existing composition identity, whisker it on the right by an arbitrary further morphism, and reassociate using the category associativity law.

proof_0319.moves: A simp/projection lemma stating what the spectral object functor does on an object; true by construction, closed by rfl. No mathematical step, just definitional unfolding.

proof_0320.moves: The pointwise subtraction of two finsets is by definition the image of a binary operation, so nonemptiness of the result forces nonemptiness of the right factor via the generic image2 lemma.

proof_0321.moves: Unfold the pointwise vadd of finsets as image2 and apply the general fact that image2 of two singletons is the singleton of the applied operation.

proof_0322.moves: Pure wrapper transport: unfold the non-dependent tree map to its underlying dependent one and apply the already-proved dependent version verbatim.

proof_0323.moves: Rewrite set membership as the contains predicate, then apply the contains-of-filter characterisation and let simp normalise the resulting boolean/Option.any expression into the stated iff. Mostly rewriting.

proof_0324.moves: Transport the statement from the internal implementation type: unwrap the tree map to its Impl, feed in its well-formedness proof, and apply the internal lemma.

proof_0325.moves: Membership in the doubly stochastic submonoid unfolds definitionally to its defining conditions, so the iff is Iff.rfl. The content is that the definition was stated in exactly this form.

proof_0326.moves: Compute the cardinality of the powerset of the naturals as 2 raised to #N, replace #N by aleph-zero, and recognise 2^aleph0 as the continuum (its definition).

proof_0327.moves: Extract the internal well-formedness witness from the Raw wrapper and hand the goal to the corresponding lemma about the internal implementation. Pure transport, no mathematics.

proof_0328.moves: The OfNat literal for n at least two is definitionally the natural-number cast, so the statement reduces immediately to the already-proved natCast version.

proof_0329.moves: Multiplication in the base semiring is the scalar action of that semiring on itself, so the multiplicative statement is an instance of the already-proved smul version for the Lid form of the tensor equivalence.

proof_0330.moves: Definitional projection: the homeomorphism built from an equiv along an inducing map carries that same equiv, so extracting toEquiv gives it back by rfl.

proof_0331.moves: Wrapper transport: rewrite the tree map as its underlying dependent tree map (membership included) and apply the dependent version of the lemma.

proof_0332.moves: Extended non-negative reals are WithTop of the non-negative reals, and the latter form an additively cancellative commutative monoid; so the general WithTop right-cancellation-for-le lemma applies directly.

proof_0333.moves: Definitional projection: the uniform equivalence reindexing a product was built on top of the corresponding Equiv, so forgetting the uniform structure returns it by rfl.

proof_0334.moves: Apply the forward direction of the iff characterising positivity of ncard for a finite set, feeding it the nonemptiness hypothesis. One mpr application.

proof_0335.moves: Unwrap the Raw tree map to its internal implementation, pull the internal well-formedness out of the Raw.WF hypothesis, and invoke the internal lemma. Pure plumbing.

proof_0336.moves: Wrapper transport: the extensional tree map is the extensional dependent one with a constant value family, so the dependent lemma applies directly.
